title: The two-zone area-allocation web component (unfitted proportional bar from document values; fitted branch deferred to M5-T173), its wording-token parity test against presentation-tokens.json, the carried G-14 conversion statement in expandable detail, and a self-contained source-links URL-form parity test. The component is built and unit-tested but NOT mounted on the default website (R096: no website illustration before the PDF one lands in M5-T173). Touches no services/api file, no benchmark-set file and no M5-T170 allowed_path.
objective: Build the absent two-zone area-allocation renderer the owner's reviewer flagged, as a self-contained component driven by the accepted 1.5.0 area_allocation block, with byte-equal wording and the carried conversion statement, plus a validator-parity test for zoning links. Deliver genuine independent progress in wave 26 without touching the frozen benchmark set or any engine file.
business_reason: The two-zone illustration (owner H1, rows R087-R098) and exact-section law links are promised report content. Building the renderer now, unmounted, lets Part B mount it in lockstep with the PDF (M5-T173) without a website/PDF mismatch, and lets this slice run in parallel with M5-T170 under the 12-helper push.
inputs: packages/contracts/schemas/v1/results.schema.json ($defs/area_allocation: label, share 0.60-0.75, measure='residential_floor_area', conversion_statement, apartment_area_sqft, other_area_sqft, total_sqft, fitted) - READ
apps/web/src/lib/results-contract-checks.ts (ILLUSTRATIVE_LABEL, AREA_ALLOCATION_* constants and checkAreaAllocation) - READ for typing
docs/design/presentation-tokens.json wording group (area_zone_apartment, area_zone_other, area_illustration_caption) - the parity source of truth - READ
packages/contracts/fixtures/valid/results/synthetic_placed_building_contract_1_5_0.json and synthetic_rear_yard_constraints_contract_1_5_0.json (area_allocation example shapes) - READ, never edited
services/api/app/drawings/report/law_links.py (official_zoning_text_url host/path/anchor rules) - READ during authoring only, to build the case table
docs/reference-cases/R6B/cases/step-p5-worked.json and real-lot.json (settled; the measure the share applies to) - READ, never re-research
outputs: A new AreaAllocation component that renders the unfitted proportional bar from area_allocation values, the two fixed-wording zone labels, the one stated percentage, the one short caption, and the conversion statement in expandable detail; fitted=true renders no bar and no second illustration (defers to Part B).
A wording-parity test asserting the component's zone labels and caption are byte-equal to docs/design/presentation-tokens.json (mutating the JSON reddens it).
A source-links URL-form parity test (self-contained positive/negative case table mirroring law_links.py's host/path/anchor rules).

acceptance_scenarios.given: area_allocation {fitted:false, share:0.65, apartment_area_sqft:12025, other_area_sqft:6475, total_sqft:18500, label:'Illustrative', measure:'residential_floor_area', conversion_statement:<G-14 constant>}
acceptance_scenarios.then: a single proportional bar (NOT zones-in-footprint) shows; apartment:other segment ratio equals share within 0.5%; exactly one percentage '65%' is printed beside it; no building footprint is drawn

acceptance_scenarios.when: its zone labels and caption are compared with the wording group of docs/design/presentation-tokens.json
acceptance_scenarios.then: 'Apartment area', 'Other building area: core, circulation, walls and services' and 'Illustrative area allocation—not a floor plan' are byte-equal (no trailing period); mutating any token in the JSON reddens the test
it draws no bar and emits no second illustration (the fitted zones-in-footprint path is a marked placeholder deferred to Part B / M5-T173); table: fitted false -> bar, true -> placeholder

acceptance_scenarios.given: every input row of the table {fitted in [false,true], share in [0.60,0.65,0.75]}
acceptance_scenarios.then: the DOM contains no room, unit-wall, apartment-count, stair or elevator text and exactly one caption (R093/R095)

acceptance_scenarios.given: the component's expandable detail is opened
acceptance_scenarios.then: it carries the exact conversion statement 'plate = zoning floor area per storey; no gross-up, exclusions or wall-thickness conversion worked' (G-14) and lists 'Physical floor plate (gross-up, exclusions, wall thickness)' as not checked; the statement is NOT in the one short caption (R095)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a positive/negative URL case table mirroring law_links.py's host/path/anchor rules
acceptance_scenarios.then: it accepts exactly the valid /article-<roman>/chapter-<n>[/<section>][#<section>] zoningresolution.planning.nyc.gov forms and rejects bare-host, wrong-host, query, port and malformed-path forms; no runtime parse of law_links.py
no file under services/api/, no benchmark-set member (G-5(a)/(b)/(c)/(d)) and no M5-T170 allowed_path is touched; the component is not mounted in ThreeAnswersPanel or any default route

risks: R096 sequencing: mounting the website bar before the PDF illustration (M5-T173) would create a website/PDF mismatch - this task deliberately does not mount; Part B mounts in lockstep with M5-T173.
G-5 benchmark freeze: the lead-refinement (DB-264/DB-261) must NOT run here because it edits the frozen three-answers-panel.test.tsx; it is Part B.
Cross-language brittleness: the source-links parity must be a self-contained case table, not a parse of law_links.py.
C2 (six status labels) does NOT block this task: the area_allocation.label is the fixed 'Illustrative', independent of the status-strip decision.
G-2 binding: the orchestrator must append M5-T187 to each cited row's applicability (digest resync + audit_log, same commit) before claim.
path_notes: apps/web/src/lib/architect/ and apps/web/src/components/architect/answers/__tests__/ already exist (new files land there).
No __tests__/fixtures/ convention exists under apps/web; inline the unfitted values in area-allocation.test.tsx (small literal) - do not create a fixture folder.
The wording-parity test reads docs/design/presentation-tokens.json via readFileSync (a docs file, allowed to read; never edited).
source-links.ts stays READ-ONLY; if a real parity gap is found, route the source-links.ts edit to the orchestrator / Part B.
The validator constants (ILLUSTRATIVE_LABEL, AREA_ALLOCATION_*) are imported read-only from apps/web/src/lib/results-contract-checks.ts for prop typing.
documented_test_commands: BUILDER DOES NOT start a server or run e2e (G-1); the real-preview readability check and before/after are the orchestrator's (deferred to Part B mount).
